Definition: Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jezreel is named 32 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Joshua 15:56; Judges 6:33; 1 Samuel 25:43. In Joshua 15:56 we read, "And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,". The same name belongs to more than one man, and 1 Samuel 25:43 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Jezreel is never just a name, and I believe a real life stands behind it. His name stands in the record, and that is enough for me.
